name: Avolta AG
note: Avolta AG (formerly Dufry AG), Basel, listed on SIX Swiss Exchange. Autogrill became part of it in the 2023 Dufry-Autogrill combination. Holders of 3% or more at 31 Dec 2025: Edizione S.p.A. 22.17%, Advent International 8.72%, Helikon Investments 5.04%, Compagnie Financière Rupert 4.94%, Qatar Investment Authority 4.49%, BlackRock 3.93%, UBS Fund Management 3.60% (Corporate Governance Report 2025).
